_readme: Edit this file, then run: python3 scripts/build.py. Events copied from Luma keep their Luma link in 'url'.

events.title: All Tech Is Human's Responsible Tech Mixer: Washington, DC
events.description: A casual Responsible Tech Mixer for people working in and around responsible technology. All Tech Is Human reserved three cabanas; food and drinks available for purchase.

events.title: ATIHx DC: Responsible Tech Happy Hour
events.description: An informal, independently organized happy hour to talk about improving the responsible tech field: responsible AI, tech policy, trust & safety, youth and wellbeing, and cyber and democracy. Attendees are asked to make a purchase at the venue.

events.title: ATIHx Philadelphia: America's 250th & the Future of Responsible Tech
events.address: Philadelphia, PA (exact address shared with registered guests)
events.host: ATIHx Philadelphia (Kristina Kroot, Alyssa Ariana Safia Boicel)
events.description: An informal evening for practitioners, researchers and community members to talk responsible tech, tied to America's 250th anniversary and the local climate. Includes a facilitated roundtable, resource sharing and networking.

events.title: IGF-USA 2026
events.venue: Museum of the American Revolution, Liberty Hall
events.description: IGF-USA 2026, held in person at the Museum of the American Revolution with an online option (Zoom details sent to registrants).

events.title: HackAI Philly
events.address: 840 1st Ave Ste 400, King of Prussia, PA 19406
events.description: Food and networking, a short AI current-events segment with trivia prizes, two presentations, and a hacking session to work on AI projects. Open to technical and non-technical people interested in AI.

events.title: POLITICO Decoded Summit: Washington, D.C.
events.description: A new POLITICO summit bringing policymakers, regulators, industry leaders and investors together on AI and tech policy, from regulation and national security to infrastructure and global competition. Program begins at 9:00 a.m. ET; see the event page for the venue and full schedule.

events.title: Fritz Digital Ethics Forum: Social Media, Children, and the Constitution
events.venue: Riggs Library, Healy Hall, Georgetown University
events.address: 37th and O Streets NW, Washington, DC 20057
events.host: Georgetown University Center for Digital Ethics
events.description: The inaugural Fritz Digital Ethics Forum examines social media, children and the Constitution. A reception follows the program.

events.title: Redesigning the Governance Stack: Taking Stock and Moving Forward (Day 1)
events.address: 500 First St NW, 9th Floor, Washington, DC 20001
events.host: Georgetown Law Institute for Technology Law & Policy
events.description: Day 1 of a two-day public symposium where the project's authors and invited experts review its findings and discuss the future of administrative governance of the information economy. Continues September 19. RSVP requested by September 16.

events.title: Redesigning the Governance Stack: Taking Stock and Moving Forward (Day 2)
events.address: 500 First St NW, 9th Floor, Washington, DC 20001
events.host: Georgetown Law Institute for Technology Law & Policy
events.description: Day 2 of the public symposium on the Redesigning the Governance Stack Project, looking ahead to future directions for governing the information economy.

events.title: ATIHx DC: Responsible Tech Happy Hour
events.description: An informal, independently organized happy hour to talk about improving the responsible tech field: responsible AI, tech policy, trust & safety, youth and wellbeing, and cyber and democracy. Attendees are asked to make a purchase at the venue.

events.title: DC Screening of BUCKS COUNTY, USA
events.address: 25 Massachusetts Ave NW, Suite 100, Washington, DC 20001
events.host: MovieGoer, WETA, With Honor and Bucks County, USA
events.description: A reception, a 30-minute preview of the documentary series about two friends from politically opposed families in a Pennsylvania community, and a discussion moderated by PBS NewsHour's Judy Woodruff.

events.title: Impacts of AI on Multilingual and Multiracial Democracy
events.venue: The George Washington University Law School
events.description: A half-day convening on the practical challenges multilingual AI raises and how technology and policy can support fairer language access.

events.title: Advance Screening: Your Attention Please
events.host: Screenwise Families DC & Schools Beyond Screens DC
events.description: An advance screening of a film about how the competition for attention on digital platforms shapes children's lives, with ideas for how families can reclaim focus.

events.title: AI Red Teaming Workshop
events.description: A hands-on session on how AI systems are tested for weaknesses, misuse and unsafe behavior.

events.title: Breaking Up with Big Tech (a club to help you through it)
events.description: First session of a weekly club for making small, values-aligned changes to everyday tech, like password managers and alternative search, email and cloud tools. Later sessions meet virtually over lunch, and the final one is back at MLK Library.

events.title: Human Friendly Tech Mixer
events.description: An informal, no-host rooftop mixer for people working in digital tech, AI, tech policy, privacy, data security and governance across industry, academia and civil society. Food and drinks are available for purchase.

events.title: Life After Data: The Conference on De-Datafication
events.address: 600 New Jersey Ave NW, Washington, DC 20001
events.host: Center on Privacy & Technology at Georgetown Law
events.description: A free, day-long public conference on how society might move past a world where personal data is the main source of value. Sessions are recorded but not live-streamed; see the program for exact times.

events.title: Book Talk with Katie Harbath: Disrupting Politics
events.description: Former platform policy executive Katie Harbath discusses her book on how tech companies have shaped elections and what AI may change next, moderated by Development Gateway's Beverley Hatcher-Mbu.

events.title: ATIHx DC: Responsible Tech Happy Hour
events.description: An informal, independently organized happy hour to talk about improving the responsible tech field: responsible AI, tech policy, trust & safety and more. Registration requires host approval; attendees are asked to make a purchase at the venue.

events.title: The Alliance After Hours: Oktoberfest Edition
events.description: A fall rooftop happy hour with drinks and hors d'oeuvres, centered on the future of AI security in America and networking with leaders, builders and policy folks.

events.title: Deepfakes + Disinformation: Navigating the New Frontlines of Crisis Response
events.description: A Trust Dialogue webinar with Edelman's Dave Fleet on how brands and communications teams are preparing for crises driven by false narratives and AI-generated content.

events.title: Book Talk with danah boyd: Data Are Made, Not Found
events.address: 37th and O Streets NW, Washington, DC 20057
events.host: Georgetown University Center for Digital Ethics
events.description: danah boyd discusses her new book on the politics and power behind US Census data and the civil servants who protected it.
